226.question: Why is not every movement of a population nomadism?

options.A: Nomadism denotes any seasonal journey
options.B: Nomadism amounts to the temporary loss of a permanent dwelling
options.C: Nomadism is possible only when crossing a state border
options.D: Nomadism presupposes a particular type of productive economy
options.E: Nomadism is determined exclusively by the distance of the migration

227.question: Pairs of oppositions necessary for defining mobile pastoralism:

options.A: The sacred and the profane
options.B: Animal husbandry and agriculture
options.C: Autochthony and diffusion
options.D: Mobility and sedentism
options.E: Orality and literacy

228.question: The pair of features that characterizes specialized nomadic pastoralism is...

options.A: The predominance of agriculture and the seasonal driving away of part of the livestock
options.B: Permanent haymaking and territorially immobile herds
options.C: Year-round grazing and a natural pasture base
options.D: Year-round stall-feeding and fodder prepared in advance
options.E: Seasonal grazing and the predominance of fodder crops

229.question: The composition of participants in a migration characteristic of a specialized nomadic society is...

options.A: All or most of the population
options.B: Only military retinues
options.C: Only caravan merchants
options.D: Only hired herdsmen working for sedentary families
options.E: Only the tribal nobility

230.question: Which relationship between the aims of subsistence, profit and exchange is characteristic of a traditional nomadic economy?

options.A: Profit is primary, and exchange has only a ritual character
options.B: Subsistence is primary, although exchange may be considerable
options.C: Subsistence excludes exchange with sedentary societies
options.D: The economy is oriented exclusively toward the accumulation of monetary capital
options.E: Any exchange means a transition to intensive agriculture

231.question: Indicate the bases of social organization identified among the nomads of the Eurasian steppes.

options.A: Territorial citizenship without regard to kinship
options.B: An individual employment contract as the basis of a segmentary system
options.C: Real and fictitious genealogies
options.D: A guild-type professional corporation as the main structure
options.E: Kinship

232.question: The ecological role played by the spread of nomadic pastoralism was...

options.A: The replacement of the productive economy exclusively by gathering
options.B: The restriction of inhabited space to river valleys alone
options.C: The displacement of pastoralism from arid regions
options.D: The elimination of the economy's dependence on pasture resources
options.E: The colonization of arid, semi-arid and tundra zones by a productive economy

233.question: The distinguishing feature of the first type of nomadic statehood in its relations with sedentary societies is...

options.A: The absence of political dependence and exchange
options.B: The immediate transition of the entire nomadic nobility to agriculture
options.C: A single economic specialization of the nomads and the townspeople
options.D: The complete integration of the population into a single urban corporation
options.E: Tributary dependence combined with predominantly separate habitation

234.question: Why is the nomadic aristocracy of the first type of state defined rather as a ruling estate?

options.A: All nomads pass into the position of dependent urban craftsmen
options.B: Military support is replaced exclusively by a hired sedentary army
options.C: The aristocracy separates completely from its own nomadic society
options.D: Ordinary nomads remain its social and military support, and redistribution operates
options.E: Kinship relations lose all social significance

235.question: The second type of nomadic statehood, with the integration of sedentary and nomadic populations, includes:

options.A: The Yuan in China
options.B: The Xiongnu state
options.C: The early Turkic khaganates
options.D: The Kushan Empire
options.E: The Mongol Empire under the first khans

236.question: The integration of the nomadic elite into the society of a conquered sedentary state usually began...

options.A: With the dynasty and its immediate entourage
options.B: With religious pilgrims unconnected with power
options.C: With ordinary herdsmen of the most remote camps
options.D: With craft apprentices of the urban guilds
options.E: With independent farming communities

237.question: The term "Silk Road" was proposed in 1877 by...

options.A: N. Yadrintsev
options.B: P. Semenov-Tian-Shansky
options.C: F. von Richthofen
options.D: V. Radlov
options.E: N. Przhevalsky

238.question: Why cannot the animal style of the Scythian-Siberian world be exhausted by the notion of decorative and applied art?

options.A: It was confined to the decoration of funerary weapons
options.B: It did not go beyond the personal taste of an individual craftsman
options.C: It reproduced exclusively realistic sketches of nature
options.D: It was a universal art connected with mythological thinking
options.E: It was used only in economic accounting

239.question: The motif that occupies the lower frieze of the Issyk kulah (headdress) is...

options.A: Paired protomes of winged horses
options.B: A mountain chain with birds sitting on trees
options.C: A cross-shaped group of tiger-griffins
options.D: A floral ornament on a ring-shaped plate
options.E: Images of lion heads above mountain peaks

240.question: The spatial scheme that forms the basis of the ternary model of the Issyk headdress is...

options.A: The past, the present and the future
options.B: The three successive ages of the ruler
options.C: The lower, middle and upper worlds
options.D: The three estates of the military organization
options.E: The east, the west and the centre

241.question: In the ternary cosmogram of Issyk, the following elements are correlated with the lower world:

options.A: Plants
options.B: The sun
options.C: Celestial birds
options.D: The horizontal cardinal directions as an independent four
options.E: Earth and water

242.question: The cross-shaped arrangement of mythological creatures on the Issyk kulah is connected with...

options.A: The order of eight funerary sacrifices
options.B: The succession of clans within a single generation
options.C: The counting of four kinds of livestock
options.D: The sequence of the three ages of man
options.E: The guarding of the four cardinal directions

243.question: Images that semantically express the connection between the opposed spheres of the universe:

options.A: The clan tamga as a private property mark
options.B: The World Tree
options.C: The World Mountain
options.D: A tally stick as an economic document
options.E: A craftsman's stamp as the master's personal signature

244.question: What function do the animals along the edges of the platforms of the Semirechye incense burners perform?

options.A: They divide the object into shares for inheritance
options.B: They indicate the sequence of craft operations
options.C: They represent a list of the owner's hunting trophies
options.D: They sacralize the boundaries of a micromodel of the cosmos
options.E: They denote only the economic value of the animals

245.question: The three ornamental friezes of the Issyk kulah are united in the vertical direction by...

options.A: The central emblem of winged horned horses with golden arrows
options.B: The ring of the lower floral ornament
options.C: A single figure of a wingless tiger at the back of the head
options.D: A row of inscriptions on a silver vessel
options.E: The square platform of a separate incense burner

246.question: The four solar horses of the central emblem are correlated primarily with...

options.A: Four generations of ancestors
options.B: The four cardinal directions
options.C: Four kinds of ritual vessels
options.D: Four clan professions
options.E: Four stages of initiation

247.question: The golden figurine at the top of the Issyk kulah depicts...

options.A: The argali
options.B: The saiga
options.C: The kulan (wild ass)
options.D: The tiger-griffin
options.E: The ibex

248.question: With which concept is the image of khvarenah (khvarn) associated in the interpretation of the power of a Saka chieftain?

options.A: The duty of keeping a written account
options.B: The military organization of decimal detachments
options.C: An inherited right of trade monopoly
options.D: The charisma of divine election
options.E: The exchange of sacrificial animals between clans

249.question: Indicate the attributes of the Issyk burial that are compared with the myth of Yima.

options.A: A silver cup as a model of the vault of heaven
options.B: A rod with a gold tip resembling an arrow
options.C: A bronze mirror as a sign of the solar disc
options.D: A whip with a gold-decorated handle
options.E: A stone altar with an image of a ram

options.A: Chinese calendar tables

options.C: The Orkhon alphabet in its entire sequence
options.D: The letters of the Sogdian cursive
